content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The FAD's finding of no discrimination or retaliation cannot be traced to documented evidence, because the Investigator never questioned Complainant on claims 1-3 and 5-9 (ROI 70-72) and the record shows no analysis connecting the evidence to the conclusion."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Most statements are cited to ROI pages (e.g., ROI at 62, 146-162, 295, 317), but the Supervisor's responses are not summarized and the conversation preceding the warning letter is undetailed (ROI at 73), so several characterizations lack a clear basis."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"The claims carry specific dates from January 23 to February 20, 2019, with the March 13 complaint, May 8 acceptance and March 18 accommodation cancellation, but the dates of the Coworker 1 EEO activity and the Supervisor's conversation preceding the February 1 warning letter are not established, so the retaliation sequence cannot be fully followed."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The FAD is reported only as a bare conclusion that Complainant failed to prove discrimination or retaliation, with no identified decision-maker, criteria applied, or documented consideration of responsive information."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"The record cannot stand on its own because the six coworkers Complainant named were not interviewed with no explanation (ROI), Complainant was only asked to verify claims 1-3 and 5-9, and the FAD's reasoning is absent, so an independent reviewer could not assess whether the conclusion is supported."}}}
